title: Memorial Day vs. Veterans Day
shared_visual_asset: Two-panel contrast card, muted/respectful tone given the subject matter.
merge_rationale: Confusability-driven — this is one of the most commonly mixed-up pairs on the entire 128-question test. Teaching them side by side fights the confusion directly rather than encoding them separately and hoping they don't blur together.
